title: Functions that take and make functions
description:
Write five higher-order functions:

```lua-norun
map(list, f)              -- a new list of f(item) for every item
filter(list, keep)        -- a new list of the items for which keep(item) is true
reduce(list, f, start)    -- f(f(f(start, a), b), c)... for the items a, b, c; start when the list is empty
compose(f, g)             -- a function that returns f(g(x))
make_counter(start, step) -- a function that returns start the first time it is called,
                          -- then start + step, start + 2 * step...; step defaults to 1
```

```lua-norun
local inc_then_double = compose(function(x) return x * 2 end, function(x) return x + 1 end)
inc_then_double(4)        --> 10
local c = make_counter(10, 5)
c(), c(), c()             --> 10, 15, 20
```

solution.solution.lua:
function map(list, f)
    local out = {}
    for i, v in ipairs(list) do out[i] = f(v) end
    return out
end

function filter(list, keep)
    local out = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(list) do
        if keep(v) then out[#out + 1] = v end
    end
    return out
end

function reduce(list, f, start)
    local acc = start
    for _, v in ipairs(list) do acc = f(acc, v) end
    return acc
end

function compose(f, g)
    return function(x) return f(g(x)) end
end

function make_counter(start, step)
    step = step or 1
    local next_value = start
    return function()
        local value = next_value
        next_value = next_value + step
        return value
    end
end

hints: `compose` must return a function: `return function(x) ... end`. That inner function can use `f` and `g`, because closures remember the variables around them.
In `make_counter`, keep the next value in a local of `make_counter`. The returned function updates it each time.
unitTests:
local function square(x) return x * x end
local function is_even(x) return x % 2 == 0 end
local function add(a, b) return a + b end

test("map", function()
    check_eq(map({ 1, 2, 3 }, square), { 1, 4, 9 })
    check_eq(map({ "a", "b" }, string.upper), { "A", "B" })
    check_eq(map({}, square), {})
end)

test("filter", function()
    check_eq(filter({ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 }, is_even), { 2, 4, 6 })
    check_eq(filter({ 1, 3 }, is_even), {})
end)

test("reduce", function()
    check_eq(reduce({ 1, 2, 3, 4 }, add, 0), 10)
    check_eq(reduce({ "a", "b", "c" }, function(acc, s) return acc .. s end, ">"), ">abc")
    check_eq(reduce({}, add, 42), 42)
end)

test("map and filter do not change the list", function()
    local list = { 1, 2, 3 }
    map(list, square)
    filter(list, is_even)
    check_eq(list, { 1, 2, 3 })
end)

test("compose", function()
    local inc_then_double = compose(function(x) return x * 2 end, function(x) return x + 1 end)
    check_eq(inc_then_double(4), 10)
    check_eq(compose(string.upper, string.reverse)("abc"), "CBA")
end)

test("counters", function()
    local c = make_counter(10, 5)
    check_eq({ c(), c(), c() }, { 10, 15, 20 })
    local d = make_counter(1)
    check_eq({ d(), d() }, { 1, 2 })
    check_eq(c(), 25, "each counter keeps its own count")
end)
